aboutHeadline: Shipping production software by day, building with AI on the side
aboutBody: For nearly five years, I've been a Software Engineer at Toast, the all-in-1 restaurant POS company, on the Payments Experience team, where I build, maintain, and improve the payments workflow inside our POS app. The recent AI boom has also reshaped how I tinker outside of work: frustrated by how hard it was to follow NHL shots on goal live, I used Cursor and Claude Code to build TopCheese — an iOS app that tracks them in real time. It's now live on the App Store for free, and it's been a fun way to keep sharpening my skills.

featuredProject.name: TopCheese
featuredProject.description: TopCheese was built to make hockey stats feel alive. Instead of drowning fans in numbers, it surfaces real-time momentum, player heat levels, and scoring threats instantly and clearly. As both a hockey fan and a developer, I wanted better live stats at my fingertips, so I built TopCheese to do exactly that. The idea is simple: surface the stats that matter most in a visual, intuitive way, showing who's shooting, who's heating up, and who might score next, so you never miss the momentum building toward the next goal. Solo-built with Cursor and Claude Code, and now live on the App Store.
